idea-plugin.name: Wasteland Terminal
idea-plugin.description:
A dark green-phosphor theme inspired by retro CRT terminals.

Includes:

  • UI theme: tool windows, popups, tabs, buttons, selection and scrollbars in phosphor greens. Uses the Islands look on 2025.3 and newer.
  • Editor color scheme "Wasteland Terminal": syntax colors for Go, PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, XML, CSS, Markdown, YAML, JSON, SQL and shell scripts, plus diff, debugger, search highlighting and console / terminal ANSI colors.
  • "Wasteland Terminal CRT": the same theme with subtle CRT scanlines across the editor and tool windows. The IDE uses the classic flat layout instead of Islands when this variant is active.

Everything stays green except problems: errors are amber-orange and warnings are amber-yellow, so they are easy to spot.

To use only the editor colors with another UI theme, pick Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Wasteland Terminal.

A matching terminal theme for Ghostty and cmux is available at github.com/chlp/ghostty-fallout-theme.
